notes.title: Whacker Guy: Distance Hunter - Update v2018_1_2_b13 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
New features include:
- Game controller support for Xbox One/360 controllers for both Windows and Mac!
- Auto game save feature on exit
- In-game Help pages for game controller/mouse/keyboard controls
- Contextual help prompts
- Additional ballpark music

notes.title: Whacker Guy: Distance Hunter - Update version v2018_1_1_b3 has been released! Available NOW!
notes.content:
Features include:
-  Addition of dynamic ball tracking
-  Adjustable setting in Options to control ball tracking follow distance
-  Auto in-flight camera zoom to provide better focus on distant hits
-  Options menu available from Game screen via <Escape> key
-  Game screen Options menu provides player with the choice of 3 ballpark settings (Rolling Hills, Mountain View, and Clear Skies)
-  Added player adjustable 3-channel independent volume controls in Options menu
- Some minor graphics cleanup


Bug fixes:
-  long foul ball that collided with upper deck and ricocheted into fair territory is now counted correctly as foul ball 
-  rare case of ball colliding with objects outside the field of play were influencing the next pitch, causing the next pitch to not be thrown.  No longer occurs with this fix
